correctness.rationale: Exact cancellation of factors in (3.1) under \(\lambda=\theta/p\) proves all-count mass equality; direct PGFs also match. Every \(\lambda>0\) is represented by admissible \(p=1/2\). The rational PGF unique double pole at \(s=1+\lambda\) with coefficient \(\lambda^2/(\alpha+1)>0\) proves the effective pair unique; the constant-ratio likelihood yields a zero score vector direction for every finite sample. Exact rational independent checks corroborate 284 cases; no finite enumeration is used as a universal proof. The theorem is explicitly marginal-only.

value.rationale: The article motivates an extended univariate count model through added exposure/weighting flexibility. The exact equivalence proves that a third unrestricted parameter adds no probability laws: all sample likelihoods are constant on a nontrivial curve, and marginal Fisher information is inevitably singular. This is a substantive structural identifiability obstruction affecting count-model interpretation and standalone estimation; it does not invalidate joint-thinning models. The general Poisson thinning closure itself is not asserted as new.
